reuse.why: Hooks into the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate that every weekend/holiday adjustment path uses, and reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate.

duplication.why: The holiday-matching rule is defined once in a small isHoliday helper; nothing is copied.

placement.why: Lives in shared/schedules.ts beside isNonWorkingDay, where the tree keeps holiday logic.

scope.why: One helper plus two focused tests; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Tiny, named, commented helper that documents both accepted formats.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Change goes through isNonWorkingDay, the shared predicate.
